tips:
**Binyan Relationships:**

Hebrew verb roots appear in different **binyanim** (verb patterns) to express different relationships:

**Active vs. Passive / Transitive vs. Intransitive:**

| Pa'al (active) | Nif'al (passive/reflexive) | Meaning |
|----------------|---------------------------|--------|
| שָׁבַר (broke something) | נִשְׁבַּר (broke / was broken) | transitive vs. intransitive |
| סָגַר (closed something) | נִסְגַר (closed / was closed) | transitive vs. intransitive |
| פָּתַח (opened something) | נִפְתַּח (opened / was opened) | transitive vs. intransitive |

**Pi'el (intensive) vs. Pu'al (passive of Pi'el):**

| Pi'el | Pu'al | Meaning |
|-------|-------|---------|
| תִּיקֵּן (fixed) | תֻּקַּן (was fixed) | active vs. passive |
| גִּידֵּל (raised) | — | causative |

**Hif'il (causative) vs. Huf'al (passive of Hif'il):**

| Hif'il | Huf'al | Meaning |
|--------|--------|---------|
| הִכִּיר (recognized) | הוּכַר (was recognized) | active vs. passive |
| הִרְגִּישׁ (felt) | הוּרְגַשׁ (was felt) | active vs. passive |

**Pa'al vs. Hitpa'el (reflexive):**

| Pa'al | Hitpa'el | Meaning |
|-------|----------|---------|
| לָבַשׁ (put on/wore) | הִתְלַבֵּשׁ (got dressed) | action on other vs. on self |
| גִּילַּח (shaved someone) | הִתְגַּלֵּחַ (shaved oneself) | action on other vs. on self |

**Key principle:** **Nif'al** makes a Pa'al verb intransitive or passive. **Hitpa'el** makes it reflexive ('did to oneself'). **Pu'al** and **Huf'al** are the passive forms of **Pi'el** and **Hif'il** respectively.
